scope: Actual battle viewport guard, fixed coin exchange and complete shop confirm handlers with synthetic DOM. Native phone pinch remains a physical-device check.

results.name: battle viewport locks native zoom and restores the exact menu viewport once
camera pointer events and noncancelable native gestures are untouched
overlapping battles in one document keep the lock until the last owner leaves in either order
viewport cleanup does not overwrite a subsequent owner change
each fixed coin pack atomically saves both exact balances once and survives reload
one jade short, unknown packs and arbitrary quantities change and save nothing
invalid balances and coin overflow cannot spend jade
successive deliberate exchanges require enough jade for each complete purchase
shop shows exact prices, affordable choices and no reward is granted on cancel
one confirmed shop purchase refreshes wallets and rejects duplicate or stale clicks
leaving the shop while confirmation is pending cannot spend later
confirmation rechecks current funds and a separate new purchase remains possible
